# arrow / arrow-csv-fuzz

arrow's own fuzz target `arrow-csv-fuzz` ([source](source/fuzz.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over arrow (apache/arrow at 70f5c269).

Five readers (serial table, threaded table, streaming, CountRowsAsync with and without newlines_in_values) run on the same bytes; their tables / row counts are NOT compared with each other.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against arrow at commit 70f5c269.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Statements ([Statements.v](Statements.v))

**Some statements are blocked by the model.** On the inputs they cover, the binary queries CPU affinity and starts threads, which this release's model does not decode, so the statements marked "blocked by the model" are false in this model for that reason alone. The program is not at fault.

| statement | in one line | status |
|---|---|---|
| `plain_halts` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model: the binary queries CPU affinity and starts threads |
| `ubsan_halts` | on every input on which the UBSan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model: the binary queries CPU affinity and starts threads |
| `asan_halts` | on every input on which the ASan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model: the binary queries CPU affinity and starts threads |
| `asan_ubsan_halts` | on every input on which the ASan+UBSan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model: the binary queries CPU affinity and starts threads |
| `asan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 2 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; ASan never fires; abort read as SIGABRT; memory refused only when forced | blocked by the model: the binary queries CPU affinity and starts threads |
| `ubsan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; UBSan never fires; abort read as SIGABRT; memory refused only when forced | blocked by the model: the binary queries CPU affinity and starts threads |
| `asan_ubsan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 2 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; ASan+UBSan never fires; abort read as SIGABRT; memory refused only when forced | blocked by the model: the binary queries CPU affinity and starts threads |

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch arrow` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
